local_light_fixture.visual_validation_limits: Sequential screenshots: clouds, exposure and moon are not pixel-locked. Wall vs open pairs isolate the intervening wall on the lamp-to-receiver path (camera path is the same and voxel-clear); wall vs wall-off isolate the lamp with identical geometry. glass vs glass-off isolate the lamp behind a red_stained_glass divider on the identical 20 cells (vanilla block light is untinted and unattenuated by glass; any color is shader-side). day-canopy vs day-off isolate the torch under the oak; solar shade is lab-geometry only (leaves treated as blocking). The walk is tick-stepped server translation (20 Hz), not per-frame interpolated motion; native-motion PNGs are at most 10 Hz/80 frames and their capture overhead pollutes timings. Predicted block-light values are an analytical flood-fill model, not measurements.
